message.content:
An editorial illustration features a seated woman with pink-toned skin, wearing a patterned orange long-sleeved shirt, orange trousers, a matching orange headscarf, and beige high-heeled pumps. Her right hand is raised near her head, while her left rests on a large beige handbag beside her right hip. Small, white, rectangular tags with strings are attached to various parts of her outfit: two on her headscarf, one on her right shoulder, one on her right cuff, one on her left sleeve, one on each of her shoes, and one on the handbag.

The woman is positioned diagonally across a light orange background with irregular, darker orange splotches. Large red capital letters spelling "TE" and "O" are partially visible behind her head. 

Text at the top reads "KOMPLOTAN SUAP BEA-CUKAI". Below the red letters, small text says "4-10 NOVEMBER 2013". To the left of the woman, large bold black text reads "ATUT&CO" followed by a paragraph in Indonesian beginning with "Harta dan bisnis..." and ending with "...orang lain." In the bottom right corner, text includes "RP 33.000", a website, "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", an ISSN, and a barcode.
